item.title: NSF invests $1.5B in foundational research for U.S. tech leadership
item.description: The National Science Foundation has announced over $1.5 billion in new funding opportunities to support foundational research aimed at advancing American technological competitiveness.

item.title: Long-term study reveals surprising link between screen time and cognition
item.description: A Finnish study following children for eight years found that higher screen time was associated with better cognitive processing in adolescence, contrary to common assumptions.
